recognize_zh: CD20 強陽性的 B 細胞呈條索或團塊狀填滿肝竇，兩側肝細胞核圓、不著色，呈現典型竇內浸潤型態，對應毛細胞白血病侵犯肝臟。
features: Strong, diffuse CD20 staining of cells packed within hepatic sinusoids
Cords and rounded aggregates conforming to sinusoidal architecture
Positive cells have round to oval nuclei with ample cytoplasm (clear halo pattern)
Unstained hepatocytes with round nuclei forming intervening plates
describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry on liver shows a sinusoidal infiltrate of strongly positive B cells arranged in cords and rounded aggregates between unstained hepatocyte plates. The cells are medium-sized with round to oval nuclei and abundant cytoplasm. In conjunction with CD25, CD11c and TRAP positivity, findings are consistent with hepatic involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Sinusoidal pattern is similar, but the cells are CD20 negative and CD3 positive.
Usually forms portal and nodular infiltrates in liver and lacks CD25/CD103/annexin A1/TRAP coexpression.
Also CD20+ and sinusoidal, but distinguished by lack of CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
